items.name: 1. Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC7 each map to a diff hunk or test; runner 528->510 lines, campaign-mode.md held at 1708, baseline lowered, no exception minted.

items.name: 2. Error Handling
items.note: Call-2 failure -> reviews.architecture 'unavailable' (non-halting); no-alternative reject -> fixed fallback string; stale attempt still fenced (exit 5).

items.name: 3. Security Basics
items.note: Reviewer prose no longer crosses a single-quoted --result argument (3f uses cat); printed at campaign end as quoted data; runner never writes its own CI ack (unchanged).

items.name: 4. Test Quality
items.note: Integration test drives the production sub_iterate/attempt_id shape through the real autonomous_loop.py subprocess; schema negatives cover 5 non-actionable shapes; a drift guard pins the reference to iteration-planning.md.

items.name: 5. Performance Basics
items.note: Prose, one JSON schema, tests; one extra reviewer call per qualifying campaign unit (accepted, same as standalone).

items.name: 6. Naming & Structure
items.note: New reference follows the campaign-step-3-4 precedent (campaign-step-3-5-plan-review.md); reason_code architecture_review_rejected parallels ci_supplychain_requires_operator.

items.name: 7. Affected Boundaries
items.note: external_review verdicts -> runner result -> schema -> autonomous_loop record -> finalize step 5 probed end to end incl. the escalated->failed row collapse and hostile prose.
